1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. A Song. To You praise [is] waiting, O God, in Zion, and to You the vow will be fulfilled.

2.w: O Hearer of prayer, to You all flesh will come.

3.w: Matters of iniquities prevail against me—our transgressions, You wipe them away!

4.w: Blessed [is the one] You choose and bring near, [that] he may dwell in Your courts; we will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

5.w: [With] fearsome [things], may You answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, the confidence [for] all the farthest ends of the earth and the sea,

6.w: the One establishing the mountains by His strength, being girded with might,

7.w: stilling the roaring of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the uproar of the peoples.

8.w: And those dwelling [at] the ends were afraid of Your signs; the goings forth of morning and evening You cause to sing.

9.w: You attend to the earth and give it abundance; greatly You enrich it; the stream of God is full of water; You provide their grain when thus You prepare it—

10.w: soaking its furrows, descending [on] its ridges; with showers You soften it; its springing up You bless.

11.w: You crown the year [with] Your goodness, and Your tracks drip [with] fatness.

12.w: They drip [on] the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are surrounded [with] joy.

13.w: The meadows are clothed [with] the flock, and the valleys are feeble with grain—they shout [for joy] [and] even sing.
